title: Why your phone dies at 20% in the cold #shorts
topic: Why phone batteries die faster in cold weather
yt_description:
Why your phone dies in the cold

✅ Cold slows the battery's chemistry, so the charge reads lower than it is
✅ It comes back once the phone warms up

Sources:
• Apple — Batteries: Maximizing Performance — https://www.apple.com/batteries/maximizing-performance/

#didyouknow #science
